bands.label: IPO and the first trillionaire
bands.summary: SpaceX debuted on Nasdaq on Jun 12 2026, raising about $75bn at a roughly $1.8tn valuation and tipping Musk's net worth past $1 trillion.

bands.label: Pre-IPO political turn and roadshow
bands.summary: Musk's politics moved hard right while bankers prepared the listing and the press debated whether the IPO would be 'highly undesirable' for some shareholders.

bands.label: Falcon, Starlink, Starship
bands.summary: Reusable Falcon 9 landings, the Starlink constellation buildout and Starship development pushed SpaceX's private valuation from billions into the hundreds of billions.

bands.label: NASA rescue
bands.summary: After three failed launches and near bankruptcy, NASA's COTS and CRS contracts gave SpaceX the cash and anchor customer that made the company viable.

bands.label: Founding and Falcon 1
bands.summary: Musk founded SpaceX in 2002 with PayPal proceeds and a reusable-rocket thesis, surviving three Falcon 1 failures before reaching orbit in 2008.

frames.label: Jun 12 2026 IPO
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins on the Nasdaq debut day, when SpaceX shares opened and Musk's paper wealth crossed $1 trillion. The arc reads as a single market event with a clean before and after. This is the frame BBC, TASS and most market desks open with.

frames.label: 2002 SpaceX founding
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins when Musk founded SpaceX in 2002 with a reusable-rocket bet most investors called impossible. The IPO reads as the cash-out moment of a 24-year private build, not a sudden windfall. This is the frame NYT business coverage and the co-founder interview open with.

frames.label: 2008 NASA contracts
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins when NASA's COTS and CRS awards pulled SpaceX back from bankruptcy and seeded its launch monopoly. The trillion-dollar valuation reads as the compounding of two decades of public money and public risk. This is the frame Al Jazeera economy desks and policy critics open with.

frames.label: 2024 political turn
frames.note: Under this frame the story begins with Musk's hard-right political turn and racial-grievance posting in 2024-2025, which preceded the IPO payday. The trillionaire milestone reads as a reward earned during, not despite, that turn. This is the frame Mother Jones and left-leaning outlets open with.
